pr_title: Register Fully Kiosk services regardless of setup result
pr_body:
If HA is unable to connect to Fully Kiosk, the services don't get registered. This can cause repair to create notifications saying that the 'fully_kiosk.load_url' service is unknown.

Fixes #85444

issue_context.title: Unknown service `fully_kiosk.load_url`
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Sometimes, my automation issues an Home Assistant _repair_ with the following text:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29582865/211211098-05d5e212-9e34-4bf3-a76a-73a061dff044.png)

My suspicious is that my Fully Kiosk tablet was disconnected (for whatever reason), and then the Fully Kiosk simply unregister its services when that happens.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant 2023.1.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Fully Kiosk Browser

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/fully_kiosk/

### Diagnostics information

There is no option to download diagnostic for this integration.

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Searching for Fully Kiosk in HA logs I found this:


Logger: homeassistant.components.fully_kiosk
Source: helpers/update_coordinator.py:168
Integration: Fully Kiosk Browser (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 2:03:57 PM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 2:03:57 PM

Timeout fetching 192.168.1.50 data
```



### Additional information

I understand that the culprit is that my Fully Kiosk device wasn't connected for whatever reason. However, I believe the current behavior of the integration is not proper. Instead of unregistering the service `fully_kiosk.load_url` in that case, it should be kept registered, but it should issue an error when calling/executing it. This would prevent Home Assistant from automatically generating _repairs_ for it.

PS: I have a single Fully Kiosk device in my house.

btw I don't see the timeout error, the only error I can find in logs is this:
`[homeassistant.components.automation.person_detected_ring_on_camera] camera events --- fire tablet to camera: Error executing script. Service not found for call_service at pos 1: Unable to find service fullykiosk.load_url`
- I tried to manually run the action while inside automation editing screen, and it works! somehow it failed when actually triggered

clarify, my issue is not this one and has been resolved. I have an old action from previous hacs integration, which is `fullykiosk.load_url`, not `fully_kiosk.load_url`. and after I deleted that integration, the old action is still inside automation but invisible from UI editor. I found and deleted in yaml editor, now everything works.
